clue.text: Obtaining expert remedy before people's treatment's beginning

parts.note: a pro is a professional, an expert
a cure is a remedy for illness
men means people here

indicators.note: the start of the word treatment is taken, its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone seeks an expert cure before a patient's treatment begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Procuring something is obtaining it, so the noun means the act of acquisition.

clue.text: Little work — fun allowed

parts.note: play is fun or amusement
let means allowed

explanation.surface: Not much work gets done when amusement is permitted.
explanation.definitionFit: A short dramatic piece is a small stage work.

clue.text: Neat border plant

parts.note: neat is an old word for cattle, so an ox
a lip is an edge or border

explanation.surface: A tidy edge of flowers lines the garden bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Neat border' reads as a tidy flowerbed, but neat means cattle.
explanation.definitionFit: A primula of woodland, related to the cowslip, is this wild flower.

clue.text: Clue women possibly will find displeasing!

indicators.note: possibly hints that the letters of clue women may be rearranged

explanation.surface: A setter warns that some women may dislike this clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Something not wanted or greeted with pleasure is disagreeable.

clue.text: Bird from Northern England

indicators.note: from shows the letters are taken out of the run of words Northern England

explanation.surface: A bird arrives from the north of England.
explanation.definitionFit: The white-tailed sea eagle goes by this short crossword favourite name.

clue.text: They give a seat to one standing

definitions.text: They give a seat to one standing

parts.words: They give a seat to one standing
parts.note: not polite bus passengers: voters give a parliamentary seat to a candidate standing for election

explanation.definitionFit: Voters award a parliamentary seat to the candidate standing for office.

clue.text: Not qualified to give the final figure

definitions.meaning: unqualified, as in complete or absolute
the sum reached when everything is added up

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both absolute or utter and the overall sum of numbers.

clue.text: The team won't be prepared to play without him

definitions.text: The team won't be prepared to play without him

parts.words: The team won't be prepared to play without him
parts.note: the coach who gets the squad fit and ready for the match

explanation.definitionFit: The coach who readies a sports side is the one who prepares it.

clue.text: Sailors in the drink

parts.note: ABS stands for able seamen, sailors
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Seamen fall overboard into the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the drink' reads as overboard, but 'in' and 'the' are letters and 'drink' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A green anise-flavoured spirit flavoured with wormwood is a strong liqueur.

clue.text: A new local's arranged to get grant

indicators.note: the words are arranged into a new order, signalling a rearrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written, the possessive adding no letter

explanation.surface: A newly opened pub is set up to receive public funding.
explanation.definitionFit: An allowance is a sum of money granted or allotted to someone.

clue.text: Return first-rate piece of bone

indicators.note: return asks for the pieces to be read backwards, right to left

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written here as AI
a bit is a piece

explanation.surface: Someone hands back an excellent bit of bone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Return' turns the whole run AIBIT backwards; 'piece of' looks like the definition but 'of' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The shinbone of the lower leg is called by this anatomical name.

clue.text: Turnovers in coats

parts.note: turnovers sound like pastries, but these are the folded-back flaps on a coat front

explanation.definitionFit: These are the parts of a jacket's front that are folded back below the collar.

clue.text: Stop one on a horse

parts.note: to stall is to stop or come to a halt
the Roman numeral for one is I
taken as written

explanation.surface: A rider halts while mounted on a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: An uncastrated male horse is a specific kind of the animal.

clue.text: Military show that leaves a permanent impression on one

definitions.meaning: an evening display of military music and drill, as at Edinburgh

definitions.text: that leaves a permanent impression on one
definitions.meaning: an inked design pricked into the skin, which stays for life

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an outdoor military pageant and an indelible inked skin design.

clue.text: Gossips going to dance discuss business

parts.note: talks means gossips, chats
a hop is a dance

explanation.surface: Chatterboxes heading to a dance chat about work.
explanation.definitionFit: Shop talk is conversation about one's work, so this means chat about it.

clue.text: Linesman who is ready to help a player

definitions.text: Linesman who is ready to help a player

parts.words: Linesman who is ready to help a player
parts.note: not a football official but the theatre helper who feeds forgotten lines to an actor

explanation.definitionFit: In a theatre, this person whispers forgotten lines to actors from offstage.

clue.text: He takes note of bungling Green broadcast

parts.note: a mess is a bungling, a botched job

indicators.note: broadcast scatters the letters of green widely

explanation.surface: A clumsy environmental programme is aired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' is the anagram signal; 'He takes note' sounds like a listener, but it is the courier who carries a written note.
explanation.definitionFit: A courier carries a note or message to someone.

clue.text: Australian capital ship

definitions.meaning: the seat of the Australian federal government
a famous P&O liner bore this name

explanation.definitionFit: It is both the federal capital city of Australia and the name of a celebrated ocean liner.

clue.text: Accused in crash involving learner driver in blind alley

indicators.note: involving means taking the other piece inside
a crash smashes the word accused into a new order

parts.note: L is the learner-driver plate letter

explanation.surface: A defendant crashed a car with a learner at the wheel down a dead-end lane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in crash' scrambles ACCUSED, and 'involving' puts L inside to give CULDESAC.
explanation.definitionFit: A street closed at one end is a dead end, the same as a blind alley.

clue.text: Yellow bird

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both cowardly and a farmyard fowl.

clue.text: No way to finish port

parts.note: O, a zero, means nothing or no
ST is short for street, a way
an end is a finish

explanation.surface: There's no route to complete a trip to a harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: This Belgian coastal town is a ferry harbour on the North Sea.

clue.text: Nursed a disabled male ballet performer

indicators.note: disabled means put out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A nurse cared for an injured male dancer.
explanation.definitionFit: The French word for a male ballet dancer is used in English.

clue.text: Fashionable writer to give autograph

parts.note: in means fashionable, in vogue
a scribe is a writer or copyist

explanation.surface: A trendy author agrees to sign copies for fans.
explanation.definitionFit: To write a dedication or signature in a book is to sign it for someone.

clue.text: Has an inclination for men who are dissipated

definitions.meaning: slopes or slants, as a stage does

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both slopes at an angle and debauched libertines.

clue.text: Beer UN brewed for old leader of Israel

indicators.note: brewing works the letters of beer and UN into something new

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: The United Nations makes beer for an ancient Israelite ruler.
explanation.walkthrough: Reuben was the eldest son of Jacob and head of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bible's eldest son of Jacob gave his name to a tribe of Israel, making him a patriarch.

clue.text: Tied in the long jump

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both fastened with rope and a single big leap.

clue.text: Correct pronunciation for ceremony

indicators.note: pronunciation means the word is judged by how it is spoken

parts.note: right means correct

explanation.surface: Someone checks the proper way to say a word for a ritual.
explanation.definitionFit: A solemn ritual act, such as a religious observance, is this word.

clue.text: Maybe ski? OK — here's where to get tickets

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters of ski and OK in some other order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether skiing is fine, then where to buy lift passes.
explanation.definitionFit: A small booth selling tickets or newspapers is this kind of stall.

clue.text: Measuring device for cats and dogs

definitions.text: Measuring device for cats and dogs

parts.words: Measuring device for cats and dogs
parts.note: not a pet scale: raining cats and dogs is heavy rain, and this instrument measures it

explanation.definitionFit: An instrument collecting rainfall measures how heavily it has poured down.

clue.text: His merchandise won't be free

parts.note: sounds like a pricey shopkeeper, but the goods are people held in bondage

explanation.definitionFit: A dealer in captive people sells human beings who are not at liberty.
